morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic [quality|feature|saint](stem) + element (Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) fused to Sinitic quality+type heads (Jin-cheng, golden-city; Da-jiang, great-river): the capital Dun-Fusang (the fort of Fusang), Iarann-cheng (the iron-walled city), Si-abha (the silk-river).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling stock keep the Mac- (son of) / O-/Ua- (descendant of) patronymic and a cland (wider clan) / fine (kin-group) name; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming), with generation-names within a zu; the throne fuses both - a flaith who carries both an O- lineage and a granted xing of the Mandate-court.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken river-duns and fallen warlord cheng: 'the Dun of [name]', 'the Cairn of the Cland', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]', 'the Drowned Rath'
patterns.military_units: the ri's fian (war-band) and the cland-host, plus the Sinitic Ying (camp/army) and the colored Banner: 'the Fian of Fusangwyn', 'the Hound-Banner', 'the Azure Banner of the cheng'
patterns.ships: river-keels and silk-traders, named for beasts and the clan's pride: 'the Silk-Hound', 'the Red Salmon', 'Raven of the Jiang', 'Pride of Fusang'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Cup', 'The Silk and Salmon', 'The Far-Sailed Hound'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set), Sinitic variants SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, rendered in the jinxian -di/-jun celestial register), never real Celtic/Chinese gods. The Goidelic warrior-clans keep their sword-and-oath powers honored at the nemed-grove; the conquered silk-empire keeps its Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, and the two are quietly identified (one power, two faces). All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic: Lawful reads the just Mandate-throne and the sworn cland-oath, Neutral reads the older clan ancestral war-dead and the local earth-and-grain powers.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fuath (Goidelic spectres) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the green mountain over the grain-altar
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron sword crossed with a coiled torc
holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-disc over a crossed sword and the seal of office

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or Cill (church/cell), or the Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (Sinitic clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified war-dead and ri of the Goidelic cland, honored at the nemed-grove and the cill; and the worthy officials and heroes of the silk-empire enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (Sinitic Gaidun-di) - the enduring earth, lord of mountains
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realtan (Sinitic Lianta-mu) - the mother, mercy, the Mother of Mercy
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Sinitic Tuli-di) - the sun and justice, the Sun-Justice Emperor

religion.the_one: Eternan (Celtic; Sinitic Aiteng) - the distant Ancient One, the Highest Heaven, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eternan - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan foremost, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the fuath (Goidelic spectres/foes) or the Sinitic mo (demon-marshals), warded and unworshipped; the cland-oath, the just ri and the Mandate-throne are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Goidelic cland-forebears and the deified ri) and the Sinitic ancestors (the zu) and local earth-and-grain powers; the great powers invoked at the nemed (sacred grove) and the miao situationally rather than worshipped wholesale

titles._tiers_note: Goidelic clanhold ladder raised to a feudal civ, ascending, with the Sinitic mandarin co-titles beneath. Toisech (clan-chief, leader) barony over a Toiseacht (chiefry); Ri-criche (border-king, march-king) march over a Crioch (border-territory); Flaith (lord, noble) county over a Flaithes (lordship); Mor-flaith (great-lord) duchy over a Mor-thuath (great tuath); Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath, petty-king) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht; Ard-ri (high-king, the one who holds the Mandate-throne) empire over the Ard-riocht (the high-kingdom). The conquered silk-empire keeps its Sinitic Wang (king-of-the-old-line, now a vassal-prince) and the five peerages Gong > Hou > Bo > Nan beneath the Gaelic crown, plus the Dudu frontier-commanders and the Confucian officials who run the cheng-cities. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage), and the Sinitic Daoshi, stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Chinese registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Goidelic warrior-clan aristocracy over the Sinitic silk-empire: the ard-ri and his cland-kin at the Mandate-throne, the flaith and ri-tuaithe over the river-cheng, the cland-sworn caur-champions of the war-band; the Sinitic mandarinate - the wang, the five peerages and the Confucian officials - serve beneath and run the cheng-cities and the silk-revenues)
titles.heir: Ri-damna (the king's heir-apparent, the throne-worthy; the Sinitic court calls him Taizi, the crown-prince)

honorifics.elder: Sinsear (the elder) / the Bixia at the Mandate-throne

vassalage.fealty: Mionn (the sworn oath) / Mengyue (Sinitic sworn covenant)
